1	# Ultra Sound Money: Ethereum's Post-Merge Supply Dynamics
     2	
     3	## Source
     4	https://ultrasound.money/
     5	
     6	## Current Supply Overview
     7	
     8	As of the latest data, Ethereum's total supply stands at **121,603,980 ETH**, with a price of **$2,243 USD** and base gas fees at a historic low of **0.1 Gwei**. Over the trailing 7-day period, the network added a net **+19,445.89 ETH** to supply, translating to an annualized growth rate of **+0.83%/year**. This net figure results from **19,638.29 ETH issued** to validators minus only **192.39 ETH burned** through EIP-1559 base fee destruction — an issuance offset ratio of just **0.01x**, meaning burns currently offset only ~1% of new issuance.
     9	
    10	The burn rate is suppressed by historically low gas prices. The 7-day gas market shows a minimum of 0.0 Gwei, maximum of 1.3 Gwei, and average of just 0.1 Gwei — well below the levels needed for deflationary supply dynamics. Blob gas (introduced via EIP-4844 for L2 data availability) averaged 7,144,934 wei with a total blob fee burn of only 0.15 ETH ($319) over 7 days.
    11	
    12	## Burn Categories and Leaderboard (7-Day)
    13	
    14	| Category | Burn (ETH) |
    15	|---|---|
    16	| DeFi | 31 |
    17	| ETH transfers | 22 |
    18	| Misc | 4 |
    19	| NFTs | 3 |
    20	| Contract creations | 2 |
    21	| L2 | 0 |
    22	| MEV | 0 |
    23	| Blob fees | 0 |
    24	| **Total** | **~192 ETH** |
    25	
    26	The burn leaderboard is led by ETH transfers (21.74 ETH), Tether USDT (13.55 ETH), and various DeFi contracts. Recent blocks (e.g., 24,850,874–24,850,879) show burns of 0.00–0.01 ETH per block, reflecting the extremely low fee environment. The 7-day burn record was just 0.07 ETH in a single block.
    27	
    28	## Staking and Validator Economics
    29	
    30	Ethereum's proof-of-stake system currently has **38.9M ETH staked** (~32% of supply). The scarcity engine locks 9.1M ETH in staking contracts with an average time span of 10.7 years. Validator rewards break down as:
    31	
    32	| Reward Type | Amount | APR |
    33	|---|---|---|
    34	| Issuance | 0.9 ETH/validator | 2.7% |
    35	| Tips | 0.0 ETH | 0.1% |
    36	| MEV estimate | 0.0 ETH | 0.1% |
    37	| **Total** | | **~2.9%** |
    38	
    39	PoS issuance runs at approximately **2,800 ETH/day**, while fee burn at current gas levels is roughly **2,200 ETH/day** under normalized assumptions (though the 7-day actual burn is far lower).
    40	
    41	## Supply Projections and Equilibrium
    42	
    43	The 200-year supply projection models ETH converging to an equilibrium of **125.7M ETH**, assuming 39M ETH staked and a 22 Gwei average base gas price. At equilibrium, issuance and burn balance at approximately **1,037K ETH/year**. The issuance rewards rate for stakers is 2.7%/year, while the effective burn rate for non-stakers is 1.2%/year.
    44	
    45	![ETH Supply 2Y Projection](./assets/figure_2.jpg)
    46	
    47	The 2-year projection chart shows Ethereum's supply history across eras: genesis (5 ETH/block), Byzantium (3 ETH/block), Constantinople (2 ETH/block), phase 0 staking, London burn introduction, and the merge (PoW removal). Supply growth has flattened dramatically post-merge.
    48	
    49	## Flippening Progress and Total Value Secured
    50	
    51	ETH's market cap relative to competing monetary assets:
    52	
    53	| Asset | ETH Market Cap Ratio |
    54	|---|---|
    55	| Bitcoin | 18.70% |
    56	| USD | 1.30% |
    57	| Gold | 0.89% |
    58	
    59	Total Value Secured (TVS) on Ethereum:
    60	
    61	| Category | Value (USD) |
    62	|---|---|
    63	| ETH (native) | $272.76B |
    64	| ERC20 tokens | $22.21B |
    65	| NFTs | $12.66B |
    66	| **Total** | **~$307.6B** |
    67	
    68	Top ERC20s by value include Dai ($4.41B), Shiba Inu ($3.51B), Cronos ($2.97B), and Tether Gold ($2.65B). Top NFT collections include CryptoPunks ($2.13B), Bored Ape Yacht Club ($0.68B), ENS ($0.63B), and Pudgy Penguins ($0.51B).
    69	
    70	The community ("fam") counts 6,000+ members tracking these metrics.
    71	
    72	![Flippening Dashboard](./assets/figure_1.jpg)
    73	
    74	## Key Findings
    75	
    76	- **ETH is currently mildly inflationary** at +0.83%/year due to historically low gas fees (avg 0.1 Gwei), with burns offsetting only ~1% of issuance over the past 7 days.
    77	- **DeFi and ETH transfers dominate burn activity**, accounting for roughly 85% of the 192 ETH burned in the trailing week, but absolute burn volumes are negligible at current gas levels.
    78	- **38.9M ETH (32% of supply) is staked**, creating a significant supply lock with validators earning ~2.7% APR primarily from protocol issuance rather than tips or MEV.
    79	- **Long-term equilibrium is projected at 125.7M ETH**, requiring sustained ~22 Gwei average gas to balance issuance and burn at ~1,037K ETH/year — the ultra sound money thesis depends on on-chain activity recovery.
    80	- **Ethereum secures over $307B in total value** and has reached 18.7% of Bitcoin's market cap, demonstrating growing but still early monetary premium.

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.oxml.ns import nsmap
from pptx.oxml import parse_xml
import os

# ============================================================
# Color palette & theme
# ============================================================
DARK_BG = RGBColor(0x0B, 0x0F, 0x19)       # near-black navy
PANEL_BG = RGBColor(0x11, 0x17, 0x24)      # card background
ACCENT_CYAN = RGBColor(0x00, 0xE5, 0xFF)   # bright cyan
ACCENT_GREEN = RGBColor(0x00, 0xF0, 0xB5)  # mint green
ACCENT_RED = RGBColor(0xFF, 0x4D, 0x4D)    # soft red
TEXT_PRIMARY = RGBColor(0xF0, 0xF4, 0xF8)  # off-white
TEXT_SECONDARY = RGBColor(0x8A, 0x95, 0xA5) # muted grey-blue
CHART_LINE = RGBColor(0x00, 0xE5, 0xFF)
CHART_FILL = RGBColor(0x00, 0xE5, 0xFF)

# ============================================================
# Helpers
# ============================================================
def set_slide_bg(slide, color=DARK_BG):
    background = slide.background
    fill = background.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18, bold=False,
                color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    tf = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height).text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = align
    return tf

def add_shape_text(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=14, bold=False,
                   color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, fill_color=PANEL_BG,
                   line_color=None, font_name="Calibri"):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if line_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
        shape.line.width = Pt(1)
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    tf = shape.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = align
    return shape

def add_bullet_text(slide, left, top, width, height, bullets, font_size=16,
                    color=TEXT_PRIMARY, font_name="Calibri"):
    tf = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height).text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, b in enumerate(bullets):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = b
        p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.space_after = Pt(10)
        p.level = 0
    return tf

# ============================================================
# Build Presentation
# ============================================================
prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

# ============================================================
# Slide 1: Title
# ============================================================
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # blank
set_slide_bg(slide)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(2.0), Inches(11.5), Inches(1.2),
            "Ultra Sound Money", font_size=54, bold=True, color=ACCENT_CYAN, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(3.1), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.8),
            "Ethereum's Post-Merge Supply Dynamics & Monetary Thesis", font_size=28, bold=False, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(4.2), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.6),
            "Current Supply: 121,603,980 ETH  |  Price: $2,243  |  Base Gas: 0.1 Gwei", font_size=18, bold=False, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

# Accent line
line = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(0.8), Inches(4.9), Inches(2.5), Inches(0.03))
line.fill.solid()
line.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT_GREEN
line.line.fill.background()

# ============================================================
# Slide 2: Supply Change Snapshot
# ============================================================
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "ETH Supply Growing at +0.83%/Year with Only 192 ETH Burned in 7 Days", font_size=28, bold=True, color=TEXT_PRIMARY)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.0), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
            "Net supply change results from issuance to validators minus EIP-1559 base fee burn", font_size=14, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# Cards
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.6), Inches(3.6), Inches(1.4),
               "Current Supply\n121,603,980 ETH", font_size=22, bold=True, color=ACCENT_CYAN, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(4.6), Inches(1.6), Inches(3.6), Inches(1.4),
               "7-Day Net Change\n+19,445.89 ETH", font_size=22, bold=True, color=ACCENT_GREEN, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(8.6), Inches(1.6), Inches(3.6), Inches(1.4),
               "Annualized Growth\n+0.83%/year", font_size=22, bold=True, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Bar chart: issuance vs burn
chart_left = Inches(0.8)
chart_top = Inches(3.4)
chart_width = Inches(7.5)
chart_height = Inches(3.5)

chart_data = [
    ("Issuance", 19638.29, ACCENT_GREEN),
    ("Burn", 192.39, ACCENT_RED),
    ("Net Change", 19445.89, ACCENT_CYAN),
]
max_val = max(v for _, v, _ in chart_data)
bar_width = chart_width / (len(chart_data) * 2)
for i, (label, value, color) in enumerate(chart_data):
    bar_h = (value / max_val) * chart_height
    x = chart_left + (i * 2 + 0.5) * bar_width
    y = chart_top + chart_height - bar_h
    bar = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, x, y, bar_width * 0.8, bar_h)
    bar.fill.solid()
    bar.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    bar.line.fill.background()
    # Label above
    add_textbox(slide, x, y - Inches(0.35), bar_width * 0.8, Inches(0.3),
                f"{value:,.0f}", font_size=14, bold=True, color=color, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    # X label
    add_textbox(slide, x, chart_top + chart_height + Inches(0.05), bar_width * 0.8, Inches(0.3),
                label, font_size=14, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Right side callout box
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(8.8), Inches(3.4), Inches(3.8), Inches(1.6),
               "Issuance Offset Ratio: 0.01x\nBurns offset only ~1% of new issuance at current gas levels.",
               font_size=16, bold=False, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, fill_color=PANEL_BG)
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(8.8), Inches(5.2), Inches(3.8), Inches(1.6),
               "Gas Context\nMin: 0.0 Gwei\nMax: 1.3 Gwei\nAvg: 0.1 Gwei",
               font_size=16, bold=False, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, fill_color=PANEL_BG)

# ============================================================
# Slide 3: Gas and Burn Mechanics
# ============================================================
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "Base Gas at Historic Lows: 0.1 Gwei Average Suppresses Fee Burn", font_size=28, bold=True, color=TEXT_PRIMARY)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.0), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
            "EIP-1559 destroys base fees; low gas = low burn = temporary supply inflation", font_size=14, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# Gauge visual (simplified as horizontal bar with marker)
gauge_left = Inches(0.8)
gauge_top = Inches(1.8)
gauge_w = Inches(7.0)
gauge_h = Inches(0.35)
# Background track
track = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, gauge_left, gauge_top, gauge_w, gauge_h)
track.fill.solid()
track.fill.fore_color.rgb = PANEL_BG
track.line.fill.background()
# Current level marker (0.1 Gwei on a 0-25 scale)
current_ratio = 0.1 / 25.0
marker = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, gauge_left, gauge_top - Inches(0.05), gauge_w * current_ratio, gauge_h + Inches(0.1))
marker.fill.solid()
marker.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT_RED
marker.line.fill.background()
# Equilibrium marker (22 Gwei)
eq_ratio = 22.0 / 25.0
eq_marker = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, gauge_left + gauge_w * eq_ratio - Inches(0.02), gauge_top - Inches(0.05), Inches(0.04), gauge_h + Inches(0.1))
eq_marker.fill.solid()
eq_marker.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT_GREEN
eq_marker.line.fill.background()

add_textbox(slide, gauge_left, gauge_top + gauge_h + Inches(0.05), gauge_w * current_ratio, Inches(0.25),
            "0.1 Gwei (current)", font_size=11, color=ACCENT_RED, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
add_textbox(slide, gauge_left + gauge_w * eq_ratio - Inches(0.5), gauge_top + gauge_h + Inches(0.05), Inches(1.0), Inches(0.25),
            "22 Gwei (equilibrium)", font_size=11, color=ACCENT_GREEN, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_textbox(slide, gauge_left + gauge_w - Inches(0.3), gauge_top + gauge_h + Inches(0.05), Inches(0.4), Inches(0.25),
            "25", font_size=11, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, align=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)

# Key stats cards
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(2.6), Inches(3.3), Inches(1.1),
               "Gas Range (7D)\nMin: 0.0 Gwei\nMax: 1.3 Gwei\nAvg: 0.1 Gwei", font_size=15, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, fill_color=PANEL_BG)
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(4.4), Inches(2.6), Inches(3.3), Inches(1.1),
               "Blob Gas (EIP-4844)\nAvg: 7,144,934 wei\nBlob fee burn: 0.15 ETH\n($319 over 7 days)", font_size=15, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, fill_color=PANEL_BG)
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(3.9), Inches(7.0), Inches(1.0),
               "Normalized Burn Assumption\n~2,200 ETH/day burn at sustained activity vs 2,800 ETH/day PoS issuance",
               font_size=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, fill_color=PANEL_BG)

# Right panel
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(1.8), Inches(4.0), Inches(3.1),
               "Why It Matters\n\nAt 0.1 Gwei, fee burn is negligible. The ultra sound money thesis requires sustained on-chain activity to push gas toward the 22 Gwei equilibrium. Until then, ETH remains mildly inflationary.",
               font_size=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, fill_color=PANEL_BG)

# Bottom note
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(5.2), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.4),
            "Recent blocks (24,850,874–24,850,879) show burns of 0.00–0.01 ETH per block. 7-day burn record: 0.07 ETH in a single block.",
            font_size=13, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# ============================================================
# Slide 4: Burn Leaderboard Categories
# ============================================================
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "DeFi and ETH Transfers Account for 85% of Weekly Fee Burn", font_size=28, bold=True, color=TEXT_PRIMARY)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.0), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
            "Burn categories and top contracts over the trailing 7 days", font_size=14, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# Horizontal bar chart for categories
categories = [
    ("DeFi", 31, ACCENT_CYAN),
    ("ETH transfers", 22, ACCENT_GREEN),
    ("Misc", 4, TEXT_SECONDARY),
    ("NFTs", 3, TEXT_SECONDARY),
    ("Contract creations", 2, TEXT_SECONDARY),
    ("L2 / MEV / Blobs", 0, TEXT_SECONDARY),
]
max_cat = max(v for _, v, _ in categories)
bar_h = Inches(0.35)
chart_left = Inches(0.8)
chart_top = Inches(1.7)
chart_w = Inches(6.5)
for i, (label, value, color) in enumerate(categories):

    add_textbox(slide, chart_left, y, Inches(1.4), bar_h, label, font_size=14, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)

    add_textbox(slide, chart_left + Inches(1.5) + bar_w + Inches(0.05), y, Inches(0.8), bar_h, str(value), font_size=14, color=color, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

# Big stats

# Donut / stacked bar for reward composition
# We'll draw a simple stacked horizontal bar
stack_left = Inches(0.8)
stack_top = Inches(3.3)
stack_h = Inches(0.5)
stack_w_total = Inches(7.0)
# Issuance 2.7, tips 0.1, MEV 0.1 => total 2.9
issuance_w = (2.7 / 2.9) * stack_w_total
tips_w = (0.1 / 2.9) * stack_w_total
mev_w = (0.1 / 2.9) * stack_w_total

bar1 = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, stack_left, stack_top, issuance_w, stack_h)
bar1.fill.solid(); bar1.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT_CYAN; bar1.line.fill.background()
bar2 = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, stack_left + issuance_w, stack_top, tips_w, stack_h)
bar2.fill.solid(); bar2.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT_GREEN; bar2.line.fill.background()
bar3 = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, stack_left + issuance_w + tips_w, stack_top, mev_w, stack_h)
bar3.fill.solid(); bar3.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT_RED; bar3.line.fill.background()

add_textbox(slide, stack_left, stack_top + stack_h + Inches(0.05), issuance_w, Inches(0.25),

add_textbox(slide, stack_left + issuance_w, stack_top + stack_h + Inches(0.05), tips_w, Inches(0.25),

add_textbox(slide, stack_left + issuance_w + tips_w, stack_top + stack_h + Inches(0.05), mev_w, Inches(0.25),
            "MEV 0.1%", font_size=12, color=ACCENT_RED, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Right panel details
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(3.3), Inches(4.0), Inches(2.4),
               "Reward Breakdown\n\nIssuance: 0.9 ETH/validator\nTips: 0.0 ETH\nMEV estimate: 0.0 ETH\n\nPoS issuance: ~2,800 ETH/day",
               font_size=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, fill_color=PANEL_BG)

# Bottom note
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(4.8), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.5),
            "With tips and MEV near zero, validator yield is almost entirely protocol-driven issuance — reinforcing the link between staking participation and supply growth.",
            font_size=14, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# ============================================================

slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.0), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
            "200-year supply trajectory converging toward equilibrium under sustained activity assumptions", font_size=14, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# Line chart simulation
chart_left = Inches(0.8)
chart_top = Inches(1.7)
chart_w = Inches(8.0)
chart_h = Inches(4.0)

# Draw axes
axis_color = TEXT_SECONDARY
x_axis = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, chart_left, chart_top + chart_h, chart_w, Inches(0.02))
x_axis.fill.solid(); x_axis.fill.fore_color.rgb = axis_color; x_axis.line.fill.background()
y_axis = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, chart_left, chart_top, Inches(0.02), chart_h)
y_axis.fill.solid(); y_axis.fill.fore_color.rgb = axis_color; y_axis.line.fill.background()

# Equilibrium line
eq_y = chart_top + chart_h * (1 - (125.7 - 121.6) / (130 - 121.6))
eq_line = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, chart_left, eq_y, chart_w, Inches(0.02))
eq_line.fill.solid(); eq_line.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT_GREEN; eq_line.line.fill.background()
add_textbox(slide, chart_left + chart_w + Inches(0.05), eq_y - Inches(0.1), Inches(1.5), Inches(0.25),
            "125.7M", font_size=12, color=ACCENT_GREEN)

# Supply curve points (simulated logistic-ish convergence)
import math
points = []
for i in range(101):
    t = i / 100.0  # 0 to 1 over 200 years
    # start ~121.6, asymptote 125.7
    supply = 121.6 + (125.7 - 121.6) * (1 - math.exp(-5 * t))
    px = chart_left + t * chart_w
    py = chart_top + chart_h * (1 - (supply - 121.6) / (130 - 121.6))
    points.append((px, py))

# Draw line as many small segments (PowerPoint doesn't have freeform polyline easily via python-pptx without XML hacks)
for i in range(len(points) - 1):
    x1, y1 = points[i]
    x2, y2 = points[i + 1]
    # use a thin rectangle as line segment
    dx = x2 - x1
    dy = y2 - y1
    length = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    if length < 1e-6:
        continue
    angle = math.atan2(dy, dx)
    # We'll skip rotation and just use small rectangles (horizontal stepping) for simplicity
    seg = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, x1, y1 - Inches(0.015), dx + Inches(0.005), Inches(0.03))
    seg.fill.solid(); seg.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT_CYAN; seg.line.fill.background()

# Era labels below x-axis
eras = [
    (0.05, "Genesis\n5 ETH/block"),
    (0.20, "Byzantium\n3 ETH/block"),
    (0.35, "Constantinople\n2 ETH/block"),

    (0.65, "London\nBurn Intro"),
    (0.80, "The Merge\nPoW Removal"),
]
for t, label in eras:

    add_textbox(slide, x - Inches(0.4), chart_top + chart_h + Inches(0.1), Inches(0.8), Inches(0.5),
                label, font_size=10, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Right panel
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(9.2), Inches(1.7), Inches(3.6), Inches(2.0),

               font_size=15, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, fill_color=PANEL_BG)

add_shape_text(slide, Inches(9.2), Inches(3.9), Inches(3.6), Inches(1.8),
               "Daily Rates\n\nPoS issuance: ~2,800 ETH/day\nFee burn (norm): ~2,200 ETH/day",
               font_size=15, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, fill_color=PANEL_BG)

# Slide 7: Flippening and TVS

slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.0), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
            "Flippening progress and Total Value Secured on Ethereum", font_size=14, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# Market cap ratios table-like cards
ratios = [
    ("Bitcoin", "18.70%", ACCENT_CYAN),
    ("USD", "1.30%", TEXT_SECONDARY),
    ("Gold", "0.89%", TEXT_SECONDARY),
]
for i, (asset, ratio, color) in enumerate(ratios):
    x = Inches(0.8) + i * Inches(3.0)
    add_shape_text(slide, x, Inches(1.6), Inches(2.6), Inches(1.0),
                   f"{asset}\n{ratio}", font_size=20, bold=True, color=color, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER, fill_color=PANEL_BG)

# Stacked bar for TVS
tvs_data = [
    ("ETH (native)", 272.76, ACCENT_CYAN),
    ("ERC20 tokens", 22.21, ACCENT_GREEN),
    ("NFTs", 12.66, ACCENT_RED),
]
total_tvs = sum(v for _, v, _ in tvs_data)
stack_left = Inches(0.8)
stack_top = Inches(3.0)
stack_h = Inches(0.6)
stack_w_total = Inches(7.0)
current_x = stack_left
for label, value, color in tvs_data:
    seg_w = (value / total_tvs) * stack_w_total
    bar = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, current_x, stack_top, seg_w, stack_h)
    bar.fill.solid(); bar.fill.fore_color.rgb = color; bar.line.fill.background()
    add_textbox(slide, current_x, stack_top + stack_h + Inches(0.05), seg_w, Inches(0.3),
                f"{label}\n${value:.2f}B", font_size=12, color=color, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    current_x += seg_w

add_textbox(slide, stack_left, stack_top - Inches(0.3), stack_w_total, Inches(0.25),
            f"Total Value Secured: ~${total_tvs:.1f}B", font_size=14, bold=True, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

# Right panel: top assets
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(3.0), Inches(4.0), Inches(3.0),
               "Top ERC20s by Value\nDai: $4.41B\nShiba Inu: $3.51B\nCronos: $2.97B\nTether Gold: $2.65B\n\nTop NFT Collections\nCryptoPunks: $2.13B\nBAYC: $0.68B\nENS: $0.63B\nPudgy Penguins: $0.51B",
               font_size=15, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, fill_color=PANEL_BG)

# Bottom note
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(4.8), Inches(7.0), Inches(0.4),
            "6,000+ community members (\"fam\") actively tracking these metrics.", font_size=13, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# ============================================================
# Slide 8: Key Takeaways
# ============================================================
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.0), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),

bullets = [

]
add_bullet_text(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.6), Inches(11.5), Inches(4.0), bullets, font_size=17, color=TEXT_PRIMARY)

# Forward-looking box
add_shape_text(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(5.6), Inches(11.5), Inches(1.2),

Investors should monitor gas market recovery, L2 adoption, and staking participation as the key levers determining ETH's supply trajectory over the coming years.",

output_path = "/app/output/final_deck.pptx"

steps.message: The 8-slide PowerPoint deck has been built and saved to `/app/output/final_deck.pptx`.
